dialogue.content: おはようございますよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: (おはようございます、こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。10時になりましたら、始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. Likewise, thank you. We will begin at 10:00 AM.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございますはじめに、年齢、性別、本日のご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします52歳、男性、娘の不登校に関する相談です
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm 52 years old, male, and I'm here to discuss my daughter's school refusal.

dialogue.content: お答えいただき、ありがとうございます。娘さんの不登校に関するご相談ですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. So, you'd like to discuss your daughter's school refusal.

dialogue.content: 娘さんの不登校について、どのようなことかもう少し詳しくお話しすることはできますか？お話ししやすいことからで大丈夫ですので教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about your daughter's school refusal? Please feel free to start with whatever is easiest for you to talk about.

dialogue.content: はい、今年の頭くらいから、学校に行けなくなり、なんとか高2にはなったのですが、行けない状況が続いています
dialogue.English: Yes, she stopped being able to go to school around the beginning of this year. She managed to advance to her second year of high school, but she still isn't able to attend.

dialogue.content: 出席日数がそろそろ限界まできてしまいました
dialogue.English: She's about to reach the maximum number of absences allowed.

dialogue.content: 教えていただき、ありがとうございます。そうだったのですね、とても心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: ええこのままでは留年なので困ってしまいました
dialogue.English: Yes. If this continues, she'll have to repeat the year, and I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、お父様としてもどうしてよいか、わからないですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. As her father, you must feel unsure of what to do.

dialogue.content: 娘さんとは、ご自宅でどのようなお話をしていますか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of conversations are you having with your daughter at home?

dialogue.content: 最初はかなり強く学校に行くように言ってしまい、そうすると娘は部屋に閉じこもってしまって、最近はあまり話ができていません
dialogue.English: At first, I told her quite forcefully that she had to go to school, but that just made her shut herself in her room. We haven't been able to talk much recently.

dialogue.content: 留年のことがあるので、今後どうしたいか娘と相談したいのですが
dialogue.English: Because repeating a year is a possibility, I’d like to discuss with her what she wants to do going forward.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: さすがに留年はさせたくないので
dialogue.English: I really don't want her to have to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、留年をもし娘さんがすることになるとしたら、お父様はどのように思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. If your daughter were to repeat the year, how would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: いやですね娘の将来に影響が出ると思います
dialogue.English: I'd hate that. I think it would affect her future.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、大切に思う娘さんの将来のことを心配しているのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You're concerned about the future of your precious daughter.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、娘さんが不登校になるきっかけはどのようなことがあったのか、お話しされていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, has she talked about what might have triggered her school refusal?

dialogue.content: それはそうですね自分の娘なので学校が合わないみたいです電車で学校に行くのですが、途中でお腹が痛くなったり、気分が悪くなったりして帰ってくるようになってしまいました
dialogue.English: Well, yes... It seems like the school isn't a good fit for her. She takes the train to school, but she started getting stomachaches or feeling unwell on the way and would come home.

dialogue.content: いじめではないようですが、まわりからいろいろ言われるようにです
dialogue.English: It doesn't seem to be bullying, but apparently people say various things to her.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、大切な娘さんと色々お話しされていて、会話をされていたのですね。娘さんのお身体のことが心配ですよね…。
dialogue.English: I see, so you have been talking with your precious daughter about various things. You must be worried about her physical symptoms...

dialogue.content: そのような様子の娘さんに対しては、お父様はどのように考えましたか？
dialogue.English: Seeing her like that, what were your thoughts and feelings?

dialogue.content: そうですね元気になってくれないとね心療内科にも行って薬をもらったのですが、やっぱりだめでしたまずは元気になってくれないと
dialogue.English: Well, I just wish she'd get better... We even went to a psychosomatic clinic and got some medication, but it didn't help. First and foremost, I need her to get well.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね、病院に行ってもダメであるとさらに落ち着かないですよね…。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. It must be all the more unsettling when even going to the clinic doesn't help.

dialogue.content: はいもう打つ手が無さそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, it feels like we’re out of options.

dialogue.content: 途方にも暮れてしまいますよね…。
dialogue.English: You must feel completely at a loss...

dialogue.content: 大切な娘さんの将来のことも考えつつ、留年のことを気にされていると思いますが、その他のご家族の方はどのようにお話しされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: While you're thinking about your precious daughter's future and worrying about her repeating the year, what have other family members been saying?

dialogue.content: 妻も同じ感じですそろそろ転校先を探したほうがいいかなあって言ってます
dialogue.English: My wife feels the same way. She's saying maybe it's time to start looking for a different school for her to transfer to.

dialogue.content: 通信だと留年しなくて済む可能性があるようなので
dialogue.English: Apparently, with a correspondence school, there's a chance she wouldn't have to repeat the year.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、パートナーさんも同じお考えなのですね。大切な娘さんのことを考えて色々な方法を探されているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see—your partner feels the same way. You’re exploring various options with your daughter’s best interests in mind.

dialogue.content: ちなみにパートナーさん（妻さん）は娘さんとはお話しはされていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, does your partner (your wife) talk with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 最初は学校に行く方法をいろいろ考えてみたのですがね同じような感じで最近はあまり話ができていないようです
dialogue.English: At first, she tried to think of various ways to get her to go to school, but it was a similar situation, and it seems they haven't been able to talk much recently either.

dialogue.content: ご家族でもお話ができていないと、モヤモヤしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating when you can't even talk about it as a family.

dialogue.content: お食事やお風呂に入る時やトイレに行く時とか顔を合わせる時もあるともいますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I imagine there are times when you see her, like at mealtimes, or when she goes to the bath or the restroom. How are things then?

dialogue.content: 最近は昼間も娘はベッドで寝ています食事でもあまり話はしないですね
dialogue.English: Lately, she sleeps in her bed during the day as well. We don't talk much during meals, either.

dialogue.content: 何してるのとか聞くくらいです
dialogue.English: I just ask things like, 'What are you doing?' and that's about it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、自宅での様子は理解しているものの、娘さんとお話しできないとしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Even though you understand what's happening at home, it must be tough not being able to talk with your daughter.

dialogue.content: はい、どうすればいいですかね？
dialogue.English: Yes... what should I do?

dialogue.content: はい、大切な娘さんの気持ちを考えつつも、留年が親御さんは将来があるので心配であるとのお話をしていただきました。この相談で一緒に考えていきたいと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes. You've told me that while you want to consider your precious daughter's feelings, as a parent, you're worried about her future and the possibility of her repeating the year. I would like to work with you in this session to think about this together. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。もし、今娘さんとお話しできるとしたら、どのようなことを一番お話ししたいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. If you could talk with your daughter now, what would you most want to discuss?

dialogue.content: やはり学校に行けるのかどうかと、行けそうにないのであれば転校の話をしたいです
dialogue.English: I'd want to talk about whether she can go to school, and if it seems like she can't, then I'd like to discuss transferring.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、高校二年生で留年が心配されているからこそ、学校のお話をしたいと思っているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's precisely because she's a second-year high school student and you're worried about her repeating the year that you want to talk about school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、お父様の中で、万が一、学校を辞めて娘さんが就職や専門学校に行きたいとお話になられたら、どのように思っていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, if, hypothetically, your daughter said she wanted to leave high school and go to work or attend a vocational school, how would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 高校は卒業してほしいと思っています
dialogue.English: I’d like her to graduate from high school.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、高校を卒業することに、こだわっている理由はどんなことがありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What are your reasons for placing importance on her graduating from high school?

dialogue.content: 少なくとも高卒でないと今後娘が困る可能性が高いと思いますでも娘の気持ちも聞いてみないととは思います
dialogue.English: At the very least, without a high school diploma, I think she’s likely to have difficulties in the future. But I also think I need to hear how she feels.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、お父様が大切に思う娘さんの将来のことも考えつつも、まずは娘さんの今現在のお気持ちを聴いてお話ししたいと考えているのですね…。
dialogue.English: I see. So while you're thinking about the future of your precious daughter, you're also thinking that you first want to listen to her current feelings and talk with her...

dialogue.content: ゆっくり今の気持ちを聴いてみたいですよね…
dialogue.English: You want to take the time to really listen to how she feels now...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、大切に思う娘さんだからこそ、本人のお考えをお聴きしたいと考えているのですね…。
dialogue.English: Right—precisely because you care about her so much, you want to hear her own thoughts.

dialogue.content: なんとかゆっくり話せる場を作らないといけないですね
dialogue.English: I have to somehow create an opportunity for us to talk calmly.

dialogue.content: そのように感じているのですね…。今お話を聴いてみて、自宅の中で少し会話をするのは「お食事の時」とうかがいましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: So that's how you're feeling... From what you've said, it sounds like the main time you talk a little at home is at mealtimes; is that right?

dialogue.content: その時くらいしか話ができないですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s about the only time we can talk.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、今の現状で、食事の時にお話しするのはいかかですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Given the current situation, how would it be to try talking during meals?

dialogue.content: いいと思いますでもいやな話だとすぐに部屋に閉じこもってしまいそうです
dialogue.English: I think that's a good idea. But I'm afraid if it's a difficult topic, she'll immediately shut herself back in her room.

dialogue.content: そのように思っているのですね。もし、よろしければ、お食事の時に、今度の週末など、お父様がご都合よい時に、娘さんの好きな場所や、落ち着いた自然のある場所や喫茶店など外に行き、ゆっくりとお話しするのも一つかと思いましたが、いかかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see that's your concern. If you're open to it, another option might be to go out somewhere to talk calmly, perhaps when it's convenient for you, like this weekend. Maybe to a place your daughter likes, somewhere quiet with nature, or a coffee shop. What do you think of that?

dialogue.content: （自宅だと現実があるので、場所を変えるということで非日常も味わえると思ってご提案してみました）
dialogue.English: (I suggested this because being at home is tied to the current reality, so changing the location might provide a sense of escape and make it easier to talk.)

dialogue.content: そうですね外に連れ出してみましょうかでも外に行かない可能性もあるので、家と両方で考えてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. Maybe I'll try taking her out. But there's a chance she won't want to go, so I’ll consider both options: at home and outside.

dialogue.content: お考えいただき、ありがとうございます。お父様としては高校の留年があり、将来を心配しているということもあると思いますが、
dialogue.English: Thank you for considering it. I understand that as her father, you're concerned about her repeating the year and worried about her future, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずは、大切な娘さんとのお話をして、今の娘さんのお気持ちを理解するということが、大切なことなのかと私は感じましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I feel that perhaps the most important first step is to talk with your precious daughter and understand how she is feeling right now. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 一度トライしてみますうまくいかなかったら、また相談したいです
dialogue.English: I’ll give it a try. If it doesn’t go well, I’d like to consult with you again.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。お父様の娘さんとのお気持ちを大切にし、また、大切な娘さんを将来を心配して高校を留年させたくないという強い思いが伝わってまいりました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I can truly sense your deep feelings for your daughter, and your strong desire not to let her repeat the year out of concern for her future.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ございません。そろそろお時間が近づいてきました。ここまでおはなししてきましたが、いかがでしたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, but our time is almost up. How do you feel about what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: うまくいかなかったら、また相談したいですが、まずは話せる場を作ってみます
dialogue.English: If it doesn't go well, I'd like to consult with you again, but first, I'll try to create an opportunity to talk.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。大切な娘さんを思う気持ちを素直にお話ししていただき、ありがとうございました。あなたならきっと娘さんとゆっくりお話しできると信じております。応援しております。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Thank you for speaking so honestly about your feelings for your precious daughter. I believe that you will be able to have a good, calm conversation with her. I'll be rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: また、お話したいことがありましたら遠慮なくお越しください。私はこの場所でお待ちしております。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Please don't hesitate to come back anytime you want to talk. I will be here for you. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでしたありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for everything.

dialogue.content: 最近暑くなってきておりますので体調に気をつけてお過ごしください。これで相談を終了したいと思います。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: It's been getting hot lately, so please take care of yourself. This concludes our session. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。このあと終了の合図をいたします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. I will now signal the end of the session.)
